note: Delivery targets used by the plan and handoff steps. Values are widely used defaults; platforms change their normalisation, so confirm against the destination's current documentation before a commercial release. This studio does not measure LUFS or true peak - see the limitations in knowledge-readme.md.

streaming-generic.label: Streaming (generic)
streaming-generic.format: WAV or FLAC master; lossy delivery generated from the WAV
streaming-generic.notes: Normalisation on playback is common, so loudness above target buys no level and costs dynamics.

streaming-apple.label: Apple Music
streaming-apple.format: WAV or ALAC source; AAC delivery handled by the platform
streaming-apple.notes: Apple publishes its own guidance; treat this as a starting point.

streaming-spotify.label: Spotify
streaming-spotify.notes: Loud masters get turned down, not up; keep true peak headroom for lossy encoding.

video-broadcast.label: Video / broadcast bed
video-broadcast.format: WAV 48 kHz, with music-only and full-mix stems
video-broadcast.notes: Broadcast delivery usually also needs a dialogue-free stem and a cue sheet.

podcast-spoken.label: Podcast / spoken word
podcast-spoken.notes: Mono is common; intelligibility matters more than musical loudness.

game-audio.label: Game / interactive audio
game-audio.format: WAV, looping assets cut to sample-accurate loop points
game-audio.notes: Deliver loop metadata and an unlooped variant for each cue.

film-stems.label: Film / TV delivery
film-stems.format: WAV 48 kHz, 5.1 or stereo stems plus a cue sheet
film-stems.notes: Follow the post house's spec sheet; it always overrides a default profile.

physical-master.label: Physical / archive master
physical-master.format: WAV or DDP-ready set, plus a 96 kHz archival copy
physical-master.notes: Keep the pre-master and one level-matched reference for every approved revision.
